ACTION: Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/discovery.md (frontmatter rules and body template, required before I write the frontmatter or lay out the body)

ACTION: Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/bulletproofing.md (the baseline shows agents breaking a rule they know under pressure, so I need its guidance on counters, the rationalization table and red flags)

ACTION: Read specs/migration-dry-run-baseline.md (to pull the verbatim rationalizations into the table, not paraphrase them from memory)

I'm reading those three files before I create `skills/migration-dry-run/SKILL.md`. The skill requires the discovery and bulletproofing references before I write the frontmatter or the counters, and I want the exact baseline wording in front of me.

The baseline failure is a rule-violation under pressure: agents know a dry run is expected and skip it anyway. So I plan to use the prohibition, rationalization table and red-flags form, not soft guidance. The description will contain only triggering conditions ("Use when applying a database migration to staging or any shared environment"), with no summary of the workflow, so agents don't follow the description and skip the body.

Once I've read the files, I'll write the SKILL.md and send you the full text. After that comes the GREEN run: the same four scenarios with the skill present, 5 reps each, to confirm the 14/20 skip rate drops.
